identityTest.stableIdentity: A governed processing activity persists independently of any dataset, system, consent instrument, request case or report edition.
identityTest.versionIdentity: Purpose, basis, operations, parties, data categories, recipients, transfers, retention assignments or safeguards change through immutable revisions.

owns: controller, processor, recipient and subprocessor role bindings
dataset, system, transfer and retention assignments

invariants: Every processing operation resolves to an activity and at least one declared purpose.
Purpose and basis remain separate attributable assertions.
A system, dataset or storage location never implies purpose.
One purpose without an accepted basis blocks activation and remains unresolved.
Consent is one basis and withdrawal is prospective and basis-scoped.
A projection never widens permitted purpose.
Derived data preserves an explicit purpose ceiling.
Controller, joint-controller and processor roles are scoped by activity, purpose and interval.
Recipients and subprocessors remain explicit references.
Retention floor and legal hold remain distinct authority-backed constraints.
Retained-under-obligation data is restricted to the obligation purpose.
ROPA is a projection and never another aggregate.
Event, effective and record times remain distinct.
No record silently asserts legal compliance or lawfulness.
Activity identifiers and revisions are never recycled.
holds: Registry allocation is pending and no identifier may be guessed.
Legal-hold precedence and person/request overlap require reconciliation.
Processing-operation vocabulary, technical-measure ownership, jurisdiction profiles and frozen audit remain incomplete.
